headline: 霍克尼雙展登澳 蜘蛛人票房夯
context: 澳洲今年稍晚將推出兩檔大衛．霍克尼（David Hockney）大型回顧展，這是他今年稍早以88歲辭世後首次在澳洲登場的大型紀念展。同一天，漫威新片《蜘蛛人：全新的一天》全球票房衝上9.32 億美元，寫下影史第二高開畫紀錄，北美本土票房達3.6 億美元，超越《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》的3.57 億美元（未經通膨調整）。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: A immersive show made with the British artist before he died is headed to Sydney, at the same time as a Hockney portraiture exhibition at Canberra’s National Gallery Two blockbuster exhibitions dedicated to the late David Hockney are opening in Australia later this year, months after the British artist’s death at the age of 88 . The National Gallery of Australia in Canberra, home to the largest collection of Hockney’s work in Australia, will stage David Hockney: Portraits in Print from September to February. The exhibition will span more than 60 works made over 30 years and offers “an intimate view of his personal life, creative practice and deep engagement with portraiture”, the NGA said. sources.summary: Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige hails ‘phenomenal’ opening, which followed box office already buoyed by The Odyssey and Toy Story 5 Spider-Man: Brand New ⁠Day brought in a blockbuster $932m ⁠in worldwide ticket sales to deliver the second most lucrative opening weekend of all time. Final figures showed the film was the biggest ever at the North American box office, with a total of $360m. This puts it just ahead of 2019’s Avengers: Endgame with $357m, not adjusted for inflation. The movie, which marks actor Tom Holland’s fourth ⁠outing as the web-slinging superhero, depicts Peter Parker fighting crime in a world that has forgotten he is Spider-Man. Zendaya, who is married to Holland, co-stars as MJ, the love of Parker’s life. The film explores Parker’s struggles ⁠with loneliness and his pursuit of human connection. Continue reading...

thread_text:
澳洲今年稍晚將推出兩檔大衛．霍克尼（David Hockney）大型回顧展，紀念這位今年稍早以88歲辭世的英國藝術家。同一天的另一則消息，漫威新片《蜘蛛人：全新的一天》全球票房衝上9.32 億美元，寫下影史第二高開畫紀錄，北美本土票房3.6 億美元，超越《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
藝文圈這邊，澳洲今年稍晚將推出兩檔大衛．霍克尼（David Hockney）大型回顧展，紀念這位今年稍早以88歲辭世的英國藝術家，其中坎培拉澳洲國家美術館的展覽，將展出他跨越30年、超過60件的肖像作品。另一則消息來自票房，漫威新片《蜘蛛人：全新的一天》全球票房衝上9.32 億美元，寫下影史第二高開畫紀錄；北美本土票房達3.6 億美元，超越《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》的3.57 億美元（未經通膨調整），這是湯姆．霍蘭德第四次飾演這位蜘蛛人英雄。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 8 月 3 日至 4 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 澳洲今年稍晚，將推出兩檔紀念大衛．霍克尼的大型回顧展。這位英國藝術家今年稍早以88歲辭世，其中一檔在坎培拉的美術館，會展出他跨越30年、超過60件的肖像作品。同一時間，電影這邊也有大消息——漫威新片《蜘蛛人：全新的一天》全球票房衝上9.32 億美元，大概是新台幣290 億元，寫下影史第二高的開畫紀錄。北美本土票房達3.6 億美元，超越了《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》。
